title: miRNA Profile in Aneurysmal Subarachnoid Haemorrhage
brief_summary: The investigators aim to investigate and understand the circulating miRNA profiles after acute aneurysmal subarachnoid haemorrhage and underlying pathological significance.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage patients within the first 72 hours or Healthy volunteers

Exclusion Criteria:

Previous neurological diseases such as stroke or dementia
study_population:
* Acute aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage patients with and without delayed cerebral infarction
* Healthy volunteers
